L10: Error and fault condition handling.

L16: Conform to either Part A (standard 11-bit) or Part B (standard + extended 29-bit).
L16: Bit coding by NRZ + bit stuffing in stuffed fields (SOF, ARBITRATION, CONTROL, DATA, CRC_SEQUENCE).
L16: Bit stuffing inserts complementary bit after 5 identical consecutive bits.
L16: Fixed-form fields (CRC_DELIMITER, ACK_FIELD, EOF, INTERMISSION) NOT stuffed.
L16: Bus values: dominant overrides recessive (wired-AND).
L16: START_OF_FRAME = 1 dominant bit; all stations hard-synchronize on its leading edge.
L16: IDENTIFIER (11 bits, Part A) transmitted MSB-first (ID-10 → ID-0); 7 MSBs must not be all recessive.
L16: RTR: dominant for DATA FRAME; recessive for REMOTE FRAME.
L16: DLC encoded per Table; only values for 0..8 bytes are admissible.
L16: CRC SEQUENCE: 15-bit BCH polynomial X^15 + X^14 + X^10 + X^8 + X^7 + X^4 + X^3 + 1.
L16: CRC DELIMITER + ACK DELIMITER + each EOF bit must be recessive.
L16: ACK SLOT: transmitter sends recessive; receivers with matched CRC respond dominant.
L16: Active error flag = 6 dominant bits; passive = 6 recessive bits; both followed by 8 recessive ERROR DELIMITER bits.
L16: Intermission = 3 recessive bits; no station may start transmission during it.
L16: Error-passive transmitter adds SUSPEND TRANSMISSION (8 recessive bits) before next transmission.
L16: Fault confinement state transitions per TRANSMIT/RECEIVE ERROR COUNT thresholds 128 and 256.
L16: Bus-off node may rejoin only after 128 occurrences of 11 consecutive recessive bits.
